headline: Aramco evacuates Dhahran HQ (first time since Iran war began), Saudi index -2.5%, FII summit postponed to 2027
dek: Aramco ordered full evacuation of its Dhahran headquarters and work-from-home (first such evacuation since the US-Israeli war with Iran began in Feb 2026); Bloomberg says an alarm triggered it. HQ houses the operations center overseeing rigs, refineries, export terminals, pipelines.
sources: Reuters (6 sources); Bloomberg (alarm triggered); JPost/RigZone/TimesLive energy wires; Dawn live blog (Trump Truth Social via Reuters)
fault_line: Is Saudi Arabia's shield broken — or is Riyadh absorbing blows to keep Washington from widening the war?

sections.what_happened: Aramco ordered full evacuation of its Dhahran headquarters and work-from-home (first such evacuation since the US-Israeli war with Iran began in Feb 2026); Bloomberg says an alarm triggered it. HQ houses the operations center overseeing rigs, refineries, export terminals, pipelines. Context: HQ tower hit earlier this month (fire across 3 floors); Oct 21 Shaybah drone (2 dead, incl Filipino/Nepali nationals) + Dammam airport (2 dead, 8 injured); coalition intercepted drones over Riyadh and Medina Oct 22; Saudi TASI -2.5% (LSEG); Future Investment Initiative postponed to 2027; UK adding defensive support. Trump on Truth Social: Iran 'doing all it could to drive up the price of oil before the US midterm elections... They are even making up fake hits, mines and everything else.'
sections.what_verified: Reuters x6 + Bloomberg independent; Brent $111.64 (Reuters) and $111.24 (CNA) consistent; evacuation consistent with Oct-21 casualty reports already Confirmed at 16:00/19:00.
sections.what_disputed: Aramco and Saudi Energy Ministry did not respond to comment requests; evacuation reason unclear (alarm nature unknown); Trump claim of 'fake hits' is on-record rhetoric, not evidence.
sections.why_matters: The invulnerable citadel empties itself: first-ever HQ evacuation under Ansar Allah fire. Pocketbook-first — Brent $111, Saudi stocks down, summit cancelled. Run the Ansar Allah damage receipts (HQ fire, Shaybah, Dammam) against the Saudi 'intercepted everything' narrative; end on Trump's 'fake hits' claim vs the 17m-bpd export ledger.
sections.context: Background: Saudi/Ansar Allah — UPDATE (ELEVATION TRIGGER already fired 16:00): Aramco evacuates Dhahran HQ (first time since Iran war began), Saudi index -2.5%, FII summit postponed to 2027; Trump calls Hormuz tanker hits 'fake' on Truth Social

Run the Ansar Allah damage receipts (HQ fire, Shaybah, Dammam) against the Saudi 'intercepted everything' narrative; end on Trump's 'fake hits' claim vs the 17m-bpd export ledger.
